szoveg_eredeti:
To celebrate Mistral Vibe and Le Chonk becoming the world’s best open model-harness duo, we’re making Vibe free in Europe for the first 3 months.

(Yes, it’s actually better than GLM / DeepSeek at coding).

Vibe is awesome on chonky codebases and fixing vulnerabilities with precision. Vibe with Le Chonk score highest among open models on FrontierCode and Terminal-Bench, and take on security work other agents refuse.

And we’re also very pleased Vibe desktop is here! Hand Vibe several tasks at once, watch the agents work side by side, locally or remotely, then review their diffs and track pull requests in the same window.

👉 Try Vibe: https://lnkd.in/dYp5PjK4
